# Recipes: real, tested code to copy

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-skill-recipes.mjs. Do not edit by hand. -->

The Facta DTE playground is a live site whose every example is a **standalone, runnable integration**
running against the staging API. Prefer copying from these files over writing from scratch: they are the
code the playground itself executes and tests. Each recipe file exports `run(facta, input)` and a
`sample` input; the comment block at the top explains the *why*.

- Playground: https://facta-playground-dev.factadte.workers.dev/ (recipes at `https://facta-playground-dev.factadte.workers.dev/servidor?receta=<id>`)
- Source (branch `feat/playground-foundation`): https://github.com/Facta-DTE/facta-api-sdk/tree/feat/playground-foundation/playground

**What to strip when you copy:** the playground adds concerns a real integration does not have: Turnstile,
a per-visitor quota and API budget, response masking, redaction and a mock mode. They live in `playground/server/`
(`guard.ts`, `quota.ts`, `api-budget.ts`, `redact.ts`, `catalog-mask.ts`…), not in the recipe files themselves,
except where a caveat is noted below. The recipe imports (`../../../mod.ts`) become `@facta-dte/api`.
The sample data (fictitious shop, customers, SKUs) is for demonstration; use your own.

## Starter files in this skill

`templates/` holds the same code already stripped and type-checked against the SDK:
`express-server.ts`, `nextjs-route.ts`, `react-checkout.tsx`, `react-documents.tsx`, `webhook-to-invoice.ts` (shared model in
`shared-order.ts`). Start there; open the recipe for the full story behind a call.
